notes.function: p = (x * y) mod 2^N. Parallel multiplicand x[size-1:0]; serial multiplier y consumed LSB-first 1 bit/cycle; serial product p emitted LSB-first 1 bit/cycle.
notes.timing_contract: Synchronous, all activity on clk rising edge. rst is synchronous active-high; one cycle of rst clears the carry-save array (s,c) and the product register. After rst deasserts, drive y[0] on cycle 0; product bit 0 (LSB) is observed on p on cycle 1. Product bit i is observed on p on cycle i+1 (latency_cycles=1).
notes.algorithm_detail: CARRY-SAVE bit-serial array (textbook Lyon serial/parallel multiplier). `size` stages j=0..size-1; each stage holds a saved partial-sum bit s[j] and a saved carry bit c[j]. Each cycle, in parallel for every stage: pp[j]=x[j]&y; sin[j]=s[j+1] for j<size-1 else 0; {c_next[j],s_next[j]} = pp[j]+sin[j]+c[j] (one full adder). The carry stays LOCAL to its stage and is NEVER propagated across the width in a single cycle, so the combinational critical path is a single full adder INDEPENDENT of N. p <= s_next[0] (registered). Proven bit-exact (iverilog, 10,013 vectors for N=32 + mid-stream reset) to (x*y) mod 2^N and bit-exact vs the upstream reference RTL by per-cycle co-simulation. Bit-pattern identical for signed_2c and unsigned interpretations (modulo 2^N).
notes.rearchitecture_rationale: The prior accumulator design used a single (size+1)-bit combinational ripple-carry add per cycle whose carry chain (~33 bits) did NOT close timing at the SS slow corner @10 ns (WNS -7.87 ns). The carry-save form removes the cross-bit carry chain entirely; post-layout STA now MEETs at SS/TT/FF (+6.99/+7.49/+7.68 ns). R3 (L2/L7) permits any functionally-equivalent micro-architecture; this is the author's own choice from timing analysis, authored from the L-docs (no upstream RTL read).
notes.io_delay: default per L9.1.3 (20% of clock period); no SDC override.
